ns2:section.sectionText: This course is designed to understand individual, societal and national response to existential crises manufactured by humans and external actors. Through the unique medium of films and interdisciplinary text, students will conduct logical analysis of global threats and; debate the possibility of viable solutions that might be implemented at the local, national and international scale.....This course is restricted to undergraduate students only.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to International Studies or Global Studies or Global Studies major(s).
